summary: The extortion group ExfilSquad breached the Police National Legal Database (PNLD), a legal reference platform used by the police forces of England and Wales, and listed it on its leak site on 26 July 2026. About 135,000 data items were taken, including names, forces and work email addresses of police officers, staff and criminal justice professionals, plus contact details of members of the public who used the Ask the Police service hosted on the same platform. The group demanded a ransom, then published the data. PNLD reported the breach to the ICO; the NCSC supported the response. The UK Department for Education was hit in the same campaign.
